name: Takamine Yuuto
source:
The game's protagonist. Guided by a mysterious voice, he finds himself whisked away to the fantastic world of Phantasmagoria. Unfortunately, his little sister is brought along for the ride, and when she is taken hostage by the king of Rakios, Yuuto is forced to wield an Eternity Sword alongside beautiful female Spirits and fight for Rakios against countries whose people he knows nothing about, dreaming all the while of the day when he and his sister will be able to go home.
[From [url=http://www.jastusa.com/aselia/chara.html]jastusa.com[/url]]
